summary: OddOneGaming showcases a high-damage Radiant Aura team for the Season 8 Boss Challenge against Joyce, scoring over 750 million damage. The key highlight is Yfeir, a premium Legendary hero who summons up to 5 clones to exploit Joyce's stage mechanic, which grants a 3% damage bonus per unit on field. The guide details hero builds, gear set synergies, stat tuning, and an 18-second ultimate skill rotation designed to maximize damage around Joyce's clone spawns.

heroes.name: Yfeir
heroes.verdict: Secret MVP for Boss Challenge Joyce
heroes.note: Spawns up to 5 clones to massively boost Joyce's stage property damage bonus while providing Attack Penalty and passive healing.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Deals massive damage when paired with Radiant Aura enablers and scales exponentially with Inspirations and per-unit damage bonuses.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Dispels the boss's self-buffs (Damage Up & Defense Up) and debuffs while providing team-wide healing and shields.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Provides Aura energy and grants the Accompanist damage boost to the ally with highest attack.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Applies Defense Penalty via Witch's Remains and shares stats; Attack stat must remain strictly lower than Talethia's.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Dispels enemy buffs once per second during ultimate and provides massive shields to keep the team alive.

heroes.name: Ardreth
heroes.note: Solid fallback choice if Yfeir is unavailable, though peak damage output drops from 750M+ down to ~500M.

heroes.name: Rose
heroes.note: Her Recharging Speed Penalty slows down Joyce's energy gain, reducing clone spawns and lowering total team damage.

heroes.name: Phaessa
heroes.note: Inflicts Recharging Speed Penalty, which throws off the boss rotation and decreases overall score.

teams.note: High-scoring Radiant team (~750M+ damage) utilizing Yfeir's clones to scale Joyce's unit-count damage bonus, tuned to an 18-second skill rotation.

meta_changes: Yfeir emerges as a top-tier niche hero for Boss Challenge Joyce due to clone-scaling stage mechanics.
tips: Do not bring heroes with Recharging Speed Penalty (such as Rose or Phaessa) against Joyce, as slowing the boss reduces clone spawns and lowers team damage.
Ensure Diantha's attack stat remains lower than Talethia's so Lincos's Accompanist buff always targets Talethia.
Set ultimate skill timings to an 18-second recast cycle so ultimate abilities land immediately after Joyce summons clones.
Equip Talethia with Dragonblood Brand or Converging Flames and aim for 100% Crit Rate using Golden Alarm.
